name: wo-list
cmd: GDP_ENGINE_LIST=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log | cut -c1-200; grep -E 'join (enumerated|exists|set)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-160; grep 'join caller failed' /tmp/err.log | tail -1 > /tmp/cf.txt; python3 -c "import json,re; l=open('/tmp/cf.txt').read(); j=json.loads(l[l.index('{'):]); s=j['set'].split(' | '); sc=j['scored'].split(' | '); print('pres', j['pres'], 'set', len(s), 'scored>0', sum(1 for x in sc if not x.startswith('0:'))); p=re.compile(r'VoteMsg\[64·x \+ y\] is 0 and 1 <= Votes\[64·y \+ x\]|1 <= Leader\[x\] and 1 <= VotingQuorum\[y\] and Votes\[64·x \+ y\] is 0'); print('IN SET:', [x[-120:] for x in s if p.search(x)]); print('SCORED:', [x[:4]+x[-110:] for x in sc if p.search(x)])"

name: preprobe
cmd: timeout -s KILL 100 bun research/protocols/engine/preprobe.ts distributed_lock two_phase_commit decentralized_lock consensus_wo_decide
